metadata.title: Property $P_{\text{naive}}$ for non-orientable big Mapping Class Groups
metadata.abstract: We give a criterion for property $P_{\text{naive}}$ for subgroups of orientable big mapping class groups and apply it to mapping class groups of non-orientable infinite type surfaces through the orientation double cover.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 给出大映射类群子群的 P_naive 判据，经定向双覆盖应用到不可定向无限型曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展已有可定向群性质的适用范围。
analysis.limitations: 需核对判据的子群假设，并非所有无限型映射类群无条件成立。 研究结论按摘要级分析；未完成正文方法核验。
analysis.priorityReason: 低维群论方向的专项推广。
